pkgmetadata.longdescription: custom ebuild for the installation of OpenAI's codex CLI. This is a tool designed to supportTerminal Workflow: Piping output, generating code blocks from strings, running automated workspace scans, etc. It is a low-overhead (Light text-only client ~50MB binary) alternative to running codex in VS Code, KDE Plasma 6 Widget, or to running the full Electron Desktop App.
